stable_state: H1 D2 with original incident widths4.25/4.00; wide blur unadopted and historical pass09 separate.
visible_question: Can a single shared encoded neutral affine tone improve the dark track without whitening away protected center color or pretending to recover absent returns?
family: C_inside=clip(g*S+b,0,1); same g,b for allRGB and both refs; clear samples unchanged; response before nativeAA2.

fit.method: One deterministic two-variable convex quadratic active-set solve, baseline start(1,0). Evaluate feasible stationary point, three constrained polygon edges and vertices, no multistart or sweep.
fit.training: Original glass valid AND NOT original held, allRGB, per-reference mean squared error with equal reference weights.

supplementary_visible_guard: Each original fixed center rectangle RGB RMSE must not increase. Original masks and metrics remain unchanged; all four historical crops reported.
zero_control: Two unit-response cached-sample composites must be bit-exact to H1. These are controls, not new optical/baseline renders or proposed images.
source_limits: Modeled hidden input, observed confidence zero and transition-state ambiguity.
stop: First strict numeric and visibly convincing candidate, four predetermined factors, invalid parameter feasibility or deadline. No new fit before primary review.
frozen: H1 geometry/source/pose/AA2/incident seeds/masks, zero lighting/shadow/dispersion, original foreground.
